Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tentative close sliding — proposed MAP update attached

Hi Sofia,

Quick update from our side: the internal evaluation committee moved the demo window one week out to the week of Oct 23 due to overlap with a gov compliance review. Procurement also asked for an extra week to vet SOW changes. That means our previously discussed close window (end of October) is now at risk.

I've attached the MAP v3 with the committee date highlighted — see the yellow column. Can we scope a minimal stability gate so we don't have to move the commitment further? Our execs would prefer to avoid a break in the quarter target if possible.

Appreciate any rapid options you can propose.

Thanks,
Jared Mills
Senior PM, Orbital Systems

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: Amelia Cho <amelia.cho@orbitalsys.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tentative close sliding — proposed MAP update attached

Jared — thank you for the heads up and the MAP.

Short answer: yes, we can offer a narrowly-scoped "stability gate" that preserves the October commitment in-flight while we absorb the one-week evaluation slip. Proposal (high level):
- Lock the feature set for the October delivery (no new eval items after Oct 9).
- Run a focused compliance checklist during the committee week (Oct 23) with a single sign-off owner at Orbital.
- Redwood will hold a hotfix window (Oct 24–26) for any critical compliance items; non-critical items go into the November backlog.

If that works we can convert this into a short addendum to the MAP that both parties sign off on. I propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to agree gate criteria and owner names.

Suggested attendees: Amelia (committee lead), Karthik (Redwood procurement/t&c), me. Any others to add?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Making inference predictable

Adding procurement perspective and a suggested gating checklist.

Laura here — quick notes:
- Procurement needs an explicit SOW decision cut-off (I recommend EOD Oct 9) and a single SOW reviewer at Orbital. After that cut-off Redwood will treat further SOW edits as a separate change order.
- For the stability gate to be acceptable to Finance, the MAP addendum should include: acceptance criteria (pass/fail), rollback conditions, and a DD window for audit evidence.

I've attached a PDF with inline redlines to the SOW draft that reflect the proposed change-order boundary and liability language.

Action items:
1) Orbital to confirm SOW reviewer (name + email) by Oct 5.
2) We will publish the MAP addendum by Oct 6 for a 48-hour review.
3) If sign-off occurs by Oct 11, we hold to the Oct 31 close target. If not, we rebaseline to Nov 15.

On the call we can walk through each gating criterion; keeping the scope minimal will help Finance accept the arrangement.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
